description: Open-source code2video templates for AI agents: each folder renders an MP4 from code (HyperFrames HTML, WebGL, Python, varg JSX with AI models).
rules: Read the template's SKILL.md first; change the inputs and config it names, not the engine.
Render in the background and check a few frames before handing over the MP4.
varg_jsx templates spend varg credits: estimate first and ask the user before generating.
Never commit media files; host previews on s3.varg.ai and link them.
